description: This shell script automates several tests related to git and Perforce (p4) integration, including starting a p4 server, initializing depots, cloning, importing, and submitting changelists with verbose trigger info. It uses external scripts like 'lib-git-p4.sh' and commands such as 'p4', 'git p4', and standard shell operations to verify functionality within a Perforce and Git environment.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts the Perforce server daemon used in the test setup.

methods.name: cleanup_git
methods.description: Cleans up the git directory after tests.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after tests complete for cleanup.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a file.
